about: What a sovereign website can do today, feature by feature: its status, live examples, the agent working on it and what is holding it up. Kept by hub.b; every line checked on the date given. Only public sites are named.

features.name: Spotify
features.keywords: music, songs, album, track, player, streaming, apple music, soundcloud
features.today: Works as links and embeds: a site links a track or album, or embeds Spotify's own player. There is no deeper integration (no playlists or listening data pulled in).
examples: Gabriel DaCruz on Spotify and Apple Music
features.agent: No dedicated agent; each site's keeper adds the links.
features.bottleneck: No one has asked for more yet: there is no request for a Spotify feature.

features.name: What it costs
features.keywords: price, cost, how much, fee, pay, payment, subscription, monthly
features.today: No monthly fee from us: you hold the site. The launch price is being confirmed; ask us for it. You pay for your own domain if you want one, and editing it yourself needs a Claude plan or a partner.
examples: Own it, do not rent it: the comparison
features.bottleneck: Waiting for the request form and for sovereignwebsite.ai's pricing page to match Dinis's decision.

features.name: Five designs to choose from
features.keywords: design, look, theme, layout, choose
features.today: Each person's site is made in five designs (two in six); the owner picks one.
features.agent: design.b and design.b.rounds (design rounds and reviews).

features.name: Your files on your own GitHub
features.keywords: own, ownership, handover, repository, files, move, export
features.today: The site is plain files in a GitHub repository handed over to the owner, who can move it to any host.
features.agent: Each site's keeper does the handover.
features.bottleneck: Each owner needs a GitHub account; Emily's handover waits on her GitHub username.

features.name: Change it by talking to your AI
features.keywords: ai, claude, chat, edit, update, change
features.today: Every site has a "Use with your AI" page and an llms.txt with instructions for the owner's agent.
features.bottleneck: The owner needs a Claude plan (or a partner) to make changes this way.

features.name: A message box with replies
features.keywords: contact, form, feedback, message, enquiry, email, contact us, get in touch, form
features.today: A feedback box on a site, with replies, and no GitHub needed for the visitor.

features.name: Google Maps directions
features.keywords: maps, directions, location, google, map
features.today: A demo site that uses Google Maps on the owner's own key and budget is built.
features.bottleneck: Waiting for the owner's Maps key.

features.name: Visitor numbers
features.keywords: analytics, traffic, visitors, stats, statistics, views
features.today: Not on any site yet. The sites set no cookies and do no tracking.
features.bottleneck: Waiting on Dinis's decisions: whether freeipapi.com may see visitor IP addresses, and which sites pilot it.

features.name: AI in your browser, on your own key
features.keywords: mistral, ai, llm, model, chat, key, browser
features.today: Guides to AI providers with browser demos that use the visitor's own key.

features.name: Instagram
features.keywords: instagram, social, posts, meta
features.today: An Instagram agent has its own site, which records its mandate and what it has done, post by post.

features.name: Private pages in a vault
features.keywords: private, password, vault, members, secret, encrypted
features.today: Pages that only people with the key can open, kept in an encrypted vault.

features.name: Your own domain
features.keywords: domain, address, url, dns, name
features.today: A site is served on a sovereignweb.site address until the owner points their own domain at it; the owner buys and holds the domain.
features.bottleneck: The owner buys the domain at a registrar of their own.

features.name: A shop
features.keywords: shop, store, sell, payments, checkout, stripe, ecommerce
features.today: Listed in the plan as an add-on (a shop without a backend); not built, and no price set.

features.name: Run your AWS from your browser
features.keywords: aws, amazon, cloud, accounts
features.today: Sign in with Google, one-hour credentials, read-only by default, and every change a plan you approve.

features.name: Who holds a domain (Whois)
features.keywords: whois, domain, ip, rdap, lookup
features.today: Who holds a domain or IP address, from the registries' own records.

features.name: A gallery of your photos or work
features.keywords: gallery, photos, pictures, portfolio, images, work
features.today: Pages of your photos and work, with captions.

features.name: Video
features.keywords: video, film, showreel, youtube, clip, movie
features.today: Your own video files played on your page, or links to your channel.
features.agent: Each site's keeper; a YouTube platform site is being built.

features.name: Writing, articles and a podcast
features.keywords: blog, articles, writing, posts, podcast, news, books
features.today: Pages for your writing, books and podcast. There is no blog engine with comments.

features.name: Opening hours and where to find you
features.keywords: opening hours, hours, open, address, location, find us, times
features.today: Any page can show your hours and address as plain text; there is no live example on a real business yet.

features.name: Bookings and appointments
features.keywords: booking, book, appointment, reservation, calendar, schedule
features.today: Not built. A site can link to a booking service you already use.
features.bottleneck: Not started: no one has asked yet.

features.name: Reviews and testimonials
features.keywords: reviews, testimonials, ratings, feedback from customers, stars
features.today: Not built as a feature. Quotes you already have can go on a page.

features.name: A newsletter
features.keywords: newsletter, mailing list, email list, subscribe, updates
features.today: Not built. The sites set no cookies and keep no lists.
